guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：海底光纜通訊系統
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Submarine fiber-optic communications
guides.concept: 以海底鏈路、放大器雜訊與維修可靠性串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect submarine links, amplifier noise and repair reliability through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「Wet plant 邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：海中纖、放大器與分支單元和岸端設備責任不同。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：只改 span 長度，觀察段數與雜訊取捨。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「纜路段數」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「通道功率」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：通道功率分配與總放大器限制須一起考慮。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：只改 span 長度，觀察段數與雜訊取捨。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「非線性累積」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「供電概念」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：供電連續性是系統可靠性之一，本課不提供高壓操作。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定通道數，只改發送功率。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「分支單元」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「纜路多樣性」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：地理分離須考慮共同海域及岸端故障。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較兩條共用岸站及分離岸站路線。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「性能監測」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「容量壽命」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：初始容量與壽命末品質餘裕應分開評估。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬一段停用對冗餘路由的服務影響。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「維修時間」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「交付證據」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：原始量測、纜路版本及限制需形成可追溯紀錄。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬一段停用對冗餘路由的服務影響。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「Wet plant 邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around wet-plant boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Submerged fibers, amplifiers and branches differ from terminal responsibilities. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Vary span length and compare span-count/noise tradeoffs. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat span counts as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around channel powers, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Channel power allocation must respect total amplifier constraints. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Vary span length and compare span-count/noise tradeoffs. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat nonlinear accumulation as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around power-feeding concept, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Feed continuity affects reliability; this course provides no high-voltage procedures. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix channels and vary launch power. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat branching units as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around route diversity, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Geographic diversity includes shared marine regions and landing failures. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare routes with shared versus separate landing sites. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat performance monitoring as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around capacity lifetime, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Evaluate initial capacity separately from end-of-life quality margin. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model service effects of one disabled segment under redundant routing. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat repair times as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around delivery evidence, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Measurements, route versions and limitations need traceable records. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model service effects of one disabled segment under redundant routing. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat wet-plant boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
evidence: 提交「復原路由」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「交付證據」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「交付證據」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
evidenceEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for restoration routes. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for delivery evidence. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

pitfalls: 兩條海纜名稱不同便沒有共同故障域。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
pitfallsEn: Different cable names imply no common failure domains. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

guides.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
guides.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

courses.overview: 由海底鏈路、放大器雜訊與維修可靠性連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect submarine links, amplifier noise and repair reliability to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 相干光纖骨幹傳輸
related.why: 可移植「Wet plant 邊界」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from wet-plant boundaries; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.transfer: 可移植「Wet plant 邊界」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from wet-plant boundaries; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理海底鏈路、放大器雜訊與維修可靠性；「相干光纖骨幹傳輸」主要處理相干接收、DSP 補償與光通道品質，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes submarine links, amplifier noise and repair reliability; Coherent optical backbone transmission emphasizes coherent reception, dsp compensation and optical-channel quality. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「海底光纜通訊系統」與「相干光纖骨幹傳輸」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「非線性累積」的對照方法至「OSNR」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Submarine fiber-optic communications and Coherent optical backbone transmission flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from nonlinear accumulation to optical signal-to-noise ratio, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

移植本課「非線性累積」的對照方法至「接觸預測」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。

Transfer the comparison method from nonlinear accumulation to contact prediction, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.
